SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, ROUND(wtmp_c, 2) as wtmp_c, ROUND(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 2 AND ts_doy >= 238
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC, ts_hour DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 4) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 297
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 4) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 297
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

  fish_date_doy as fished_doy,
  return_date_doy as return_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND cls = 'day_1_5' AND fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 297
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, return_date_doy
